Historical ModelCard says price rendered; current card has provider/name/state only.
Historical TraderConfigModal says initial-balance picker; current form has cadence and position mode, no initial-balance field.
Historic getAIConfig/normalize summary claims filling missing defaults; actual getAIConfig returns null without legacy fields and normalization selects fields.
PauseButton and newer PlanCard/health/ledger consumers absent from old snapshot; current imports and exact source supersede graph.
